Title: Override requested
Details: A control exception or threshold override has been logged with supporting evidence.

Title: Risk and control review
Details: The override is checked against policy, threshold, and segregation requirements.

Title: Approval and expiry set
Details: Approved overrides must have a named approver, expiry date, and follow-up action.

Title: Register monitored
Details: Expired or unresolved overrides should escalate to compliance review.
